name: heartbreak-hub
description: A scientifically-backed emotional recovery platform that transforms heartbreak into personal transformation. Features personalized healing pathways, mood journaling, milestone tracking, group cohorts, and professional resources.

userStories.title: Project Setup & Infrastructure
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the base Next.js 14 project configured with Supabase, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui so that we have a solid foundation to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js 14 app created with App Router
Supabase client configured with environment variables
Tailwind CSS configured with custom color palette (calming, healing colors - soft purples, teals, warm neutrals)
shadcn/ui initialized with button, card, input, and form components
Base layout with responsive container created
Environment variables template (.env.example) created
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Database Schema Design
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the complete database schema created so that all features have proper data storage.
acceptanceCriteria: user_profiles table (id, user_id, display_name, breakup_type, time_since, pathway_id, show_days_counter, created_at)
pathways table (id, name, description, duration_days, icon)
pathway_content table (id, pathway_id, day_number, type, title, content, exercise_prompt)
cohorts table (id, pathway_id, start_date, max_members, breakup_type_match, status)
cohort_members table (id, cohort_id, user_id, anonymous_name, joined_at)
user_progress table (id, user_id, pathway_id, current_day, recovery_score, streak_count, milestones_json, updated_at)
journal_entries table (id, user_id, content, mood_score, created_at)
milestones table (id, name, description, icon, points, criteria_type)
therapist_directory table (id, name, specialty, location, website_url, description)
content_library table (id, title, description, category, tags, content_url, is_premium, pathway_id)
encouragements table (id, cohort_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, feed_item_type, created_at)
bookmarks table (id, user_id, content_id, created_at)
Row Level Security policies for all tables ensuring users can only access their own data
Seed data for 3 pathways with descriptions
Seed data for 6 milestones
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Authentication System
userStories.description: As a user, I want to sign up/login with email, Google, or Apple so that I can save my progress, or browse anonymously to explore the app first.
acceptanceCriteria: Supabase Auth configured with email/password provider
Google OAuth provider configured in Supabase settings
Apple OAuth provider configured in Supabase settings
Login page at /login with email, Google, and Apple sign-in buttons
Sign up page at /signup with all three options
Auth context/provider created for managing user state across app
useUser hook for accessing current user
Protected route middleware that redirects unauthenticated users from protected pages
Public pages (/, /content-preview) accessible without authentication
Logout functionality that clears session and redirects to home
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Landing Page
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see a compelling landing page so that I understand the app's value and sign up.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section with empathetic headline ('Your healing journey starts here') and primary CTA button
How it works section with 3 steps: Take Quiz, Join Cohort, Track Progress
Features overview section highlighting pathways, community, and tracking
Testimonials section with 3 placeholder testimonials
Final CTA section with 'Start Your Healing Journey' button linking to /quiz
Footer with links to About, Privacy, Terms
Mobile-responsive design using Tailwind breakpoints
Calming color scheme consistent with brand
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Onboarding Quiz
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to complete a quick quiz about my breakup so that I get matched with the right recovery pathway.
acceptanceCriteria: Quiz page at /quiz with step-by-step multi-page flow
Question 1: Breakup type with options (mutual, blindsided, complicated, other)
Question 2: Time since breakup (less than 1 week, 1-4 weeks, 1-3 months, 3+ months)
Progress indicator bar showing current step (1/2, 2/2)
Back button to return to previous question
Results stored in user_profiles table when user is authenticated
Results stored in localStorage for anonymous users
Matching algorithm: blindsided + <1 month = Fresh Breakup, >3 months = Moving Forward, else = Long-term Healing
Redirect to /pathways with recommendation after completion
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Recovery Pathways Display
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my recommended pathway and the other available options so that I can choose my recovery journey.
acceptanceCriteria: Pathways page at /pathways showing all 3 pathway cards
Recommended pathway highlighted with 'Recommended for you' badge based on quiz results
Fresh Breakup pathway card: 21 days, immediate coping and stabilization focus
Long-term Healing pathway card: 45 days, deep processing and growth focus
Moving Forward pathway card: 30 days, rebuilding and new beginnings focus
Each card shows: name, duration, description, and 'Select' button
User can select any pathway regardless of recommendation
Selection saves pathway_id to user_profiles table
After selection, redirect to /dashboard
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Daily Content & Exercises
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my daily content and exercises so that I have actionable steps for my recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page at /dashboard showing current day's content
Daily content card with: inspirational quote, article snippet, exercise prompt
Text input area for exercise reflection response
Save & Complete button that marks day as complete
Content unlocks day-by-day (can view current day and past days only)
Past days accessible via 'Previous Days' dropdown or list
Current day number displayed prominently ('Day 5 of 21')
Content fetched from pathway_content table based on user's pathway and current_day
Progress updates user_progress.current_day on completion
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Mood Journaling
userStories.description: As a user, I want to log my daily mood and write journal entries so that I can track my emotional patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Journal page at /journal accessible from navigation
Mood selector with 1-10 scale using emoji faces (1=very sad, 10=very happy)
Free-form text area for journal entry with placeholder prompt suggestions
Optional prompt suggestions button that shows 3 writing prompts
Save Entry button that stores to journal_entries table with mood_score and content
Past entries list showing date, mood emoji, and preview of content
Click on past entry to view full content in modal or expanded view
Date filter to browse entries by month
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Milestone System
userStories.description: As a user, I want to earn milestones for my progress so that I feel motivated and can see how far I've come.
acceptanceCriteria: 6 milestone definitions seeded: First Journal Entry, 7-Day Streak, Completed Week 1, Shared Encouragement, Halfway There, Program Complete
Milestone detection logic that checks criteria after relevant actions
Toast notification displayed when milestone is earned
Milestones page at /milestones showing all milestones in a grid
Earned milestones shown with full color and checkmark
Locked milestones shown grayed out with criteria hint
Each milestone displays: icon, name, description, points value
Total recovery score calculated as sum of earned milestone points
Earned milestones stored in user_progress.milestones_json array
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Recovery Score Dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my recovery score and progress visualization so that I can track my transformation.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress dashboard widget on /dashboard page (above or beside daily content)
Recovery score displayed prominently as large number with label
Progress bar showing days completed vs total pathway days (e.g., 5/21)
Current streak counter showing consecutive days active
Mini mood graph showing last 7 journal entries as small line or bar chart
Optional 'Days since breakup' counter (respects user preference to hide)
All stats update in real-time when actions are taken
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Cohort Listing & Enrollment
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see available cohorts and join one so that I can recover alongside others in a similar situation.
acceptanceCriteria: Cohorts page at /cohorts listing upcoming cohorts as cards
Each cohort card shows: pathway name, start date, spots remaining (max_members - current), breakup type match
Filter dropdown to filter cohorts by pathway type
Join Cohort button on each card (requires authentication)
Confirmation modal before joining with cohort details
On confirm, user added to cohort_members with auto-generated anonymous_name (e.g., 'Healing Heart #4')
User can only be in one active cohort at a time (show 'Already in cohort' message)
Cohort card shows 'Full' badge and disables join when max_members reached
bun run typecheck passes
bun run lint passes

userStories.title: Cohort Progress Feed
userStories.description: As a user in a cohort, I want to see my cohort members' progress so that I feel supported and connected.
acceptanceCriteria: Cohort feed page at /cohort/feed showing member activity

Encouragement counter shown on each item (e.g., '3 cheers')
User's own progress also appears in feed with 'You' label
Feed sorted by most recent activity at top
Empty state message if no cohort activity yet

userStories.title: Mobile-Responsive Navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want intuitive navigation that works on mobile so that I can use the app anywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom navigation bar for mobile (< 768px) with 5 icons: Home, Journal, Cohort, Library, Profile
Side navigation drawer for desktop (>= 768px) with same items plus labels
Active state indicator (highlight/underline) on current page
Navigation icons use consistent icon library (lucide-react)
Smooth page transitions without full reload (Next.js navigation)
All main pages accessible within 2 taps from any page
Navigation hides on scroll down, shows on scroll up (mobile only)
